title: Orange Skillet Chocolate Cake
description: A moist and flavorful chocolate cake made with fresh orange zest and a hint of American spice.
instructions: Grease the 9-inch round skillet with infused oil.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs and infused oil.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Stir in the orange zest and chocolate chips.
Pour the batter into the prepared skillet and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the cake cool in the skillet for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
